title: Plan 9: Not dead, Just Resting, by Ori Bernstein
summary: Ori Bernstein gives an overview of Plan 9 at a NYC*BUG meeting. He explains what the system is, how it is built, what has happened since Bell Labs, and what its design teaches, with a live demo.
why: HN mostly cites it as background on Plan 9 and its ideas, with one commenter thanking the speaker for an enjoyable talk.

quote.text: I particularly enjoyed your video talk
